text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The State Audit Office suggests more state subsidies should go to shipping company Mahart Rt which has lost half of its market.
- A house that burned down last night on the outskirts of Budapest might have been set on fire deliberately.
- Three men were arrested as suspects in the killing of a British national early on Tuesday.
- A dozen supporters of the opposition Hungarian Workers' Party staged a protest against stationing nuclear weapons in Hungary.
- Unions continue to debate the mandating system for the leadership of the social security self-governments.
